scope: Direct evaluator measurements over settled local records and synthetic events. No hook invocation, installation, external operator evidence, code quality certification or live-session proof. Source pins certify current fixture bytes only.
failure_policy: Changed selected inputs invalidate this evidence and require re-measurement and re-derivation of dependency waves; unavailable operator or outside evidence = EXTERNAL.
replay: Verify every source_pins SHA-256 and selected_input_digest before reuse. For each observation reconstruct settled Obs values (objects, written and created as frozensets; search as tuple), Record.turn_start and user_texts, and pass the saved rows and event to evaluate. Recreate each optional_words_fixture in a temporary directory and replace its row words path. Compare None or the expected row and the complete Finding schema. Re-run the recorded unit and model checks. Limits describe scope, not a measured live outcome.
